other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Passing mention of oil pipelines as the original use-case that MQTT was developed for; this is protocol history, not an application context of the paper
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The MQTT communication protocol was originally 
developed for the satellite-based connection of oil pipelines.

one_line: The paper develops a conceptual universal energy information model (UEIM) for standardizing energy management data semantics over OPC UA/MQTT in generic industrial automation (using discrete-manufacturing examples such as industrial robots and motor protection breakers), with no application to any continuous-flow production sector.
